reuse.why: The new action reuses getBulkBudgetCategories, averageToBudget, spreadsheet access, budget writes, and undo wrappers, while group-tag detection uses extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: Category eligibility and amount-sign decisions remain shared rather than being copied into individual actions.

placement.why: Selection policy and budget operations stay in budget/actions.ts, with handler registration in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The changes address the requested budget actions and tests, apart from an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: A shared argument type and centralized eligibility policy keep future rule changes localized while preserving existing missing-group variations explicitly.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected month-wide actions use getBulkBudgetCategories, and setLastMonthSpending also uses averageToBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated decision logic is concealed through renaming or restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories renames its existing hidden-category parameter and adds one group-tag exclusion branch; template exclusion is centralized in its query, with no consumer-specific branches or bypasses.
